description: The #71 pump detector on a held saw chord at 128 BPM under an exponential duck: depth and time back within 1.5 dB.

issue_figures.why: a row reproduces within 0.5 dB of depth and 30 % of the time back; the issue does not give its chord phases

name: 71-pump

recipe.beats_counted: a beat counts when it starts 50 ms or more after 0 s and ends by the end
recipe.chord: saws of the envelope tests, each at phase uniform(1, 3) cycles in chord order, summed and scaled to a peak of 0.5, held from 0 s to the end
recipe.curve: 64 phase bins per beat, each beat minus its 90th percentile, the median over the beats
recipe.duck: gain 1 - (1 - 10^(-depth / 20)) exp(-(t mod beat) / release) on every beat from 0 s
recipe.recovery: from the curve's minimum, over the beat's wrap, until it comes back within 1.5 dB, linear between bins
recipe.track: centred RMS in dB over two periods of 110 Hz on a 1 ms hop from 0 s to the end

tolerance_note: depth within 0.01 dB and time back within 0.01 s: both sides bin the same frames, and the saws differ only in the last bits of their sines
